name: Osufi Serum 300 ml | Osufi Moisturizing Brightening Firming Essence Collagen Toner 300ml | Osufi King Badshah Face Serum
description:
Brand: Osufi
Product Type: Face Serum / Essence Toner
Variant: Moisturizing, Brightening & Firming Collagen Serum
Net Volume: 300ml

Key Benefits

Collagen-Enriched Formula: Helps reduce wrinkles, fine lines, and improve skin elasticity.

Anti-Aging Properties: Firms the skin, promotes youthful appearance, and smoothens texture.

Deep Absorption: Active gold ion technology improves skin absorption 10x faster.

Moisturizing & Brightening: Provides long-lasting hydration while brightening dull skin.

Multi-Purpose Use:

Can be used as a toner / cosmetic water before make-up.

Enhances absorption of lotions and creams.

Suitable for daily skincare routine.
